🚀 liam | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Visualizing database schemas through automatically generated ER diagrams.
✨ Key Features: • Generates beautiful and interactive ER diagrams • Seamless reverse engineering from existing database schemas • Zero configuration setup • High performance, handles 100+ tables • Fully open-source
📖 Summary: Liam ERD is an open-source tool that automatically generates beautiful, interactive Entity Relationship (ER) diagrams from your database schemas. It offers a seamless reverse-engineering process with zero configuration, providing high performance for projects of all sizes and an intuitive user interface for easy schema visualization.
